extracted.name: Dried Beef Ball
extracted.description: This is a favorite cocktail-party item, using cream cheese and dried beef, seasoned with Worcestershire sauce and green onions. Recipe can be multiplied.
instruction_lines: Set aside 1/2 cup dried beef. Combine remaining dried beef, cream cheese, green onions, Worcestershire sauce, and seasoned salt in a bowl. Mix well and roll into a ball.
Roll ball in reserved dried beef until entire outside of ball coated.
